en: Long ago I was a sharp-looking young man, and my wife was a fine-looking girl. This is a story from those days.
Right around here, a certain Pokémon once put Tornadus and Thundurus in their place, after they'd stirred up storms and thunder across the whole region.
I'll show you a picture of each. This is Tornadus!
Tornadus and Thundurus have been registered in the Pokédex.
The Pokémon that quieted the pair is known as Landorus. Feast your eyes!
Landorus has been registered in the Pokédex.
I heard there's a shrine to Landorus somewhere along Route 14. Maybe you'll go and see it.
Tornadus and Thundurus were wild, and Landorus brought them back to order. A good story, I always think.
Oh, dear. Your team looks a bit sluggish. Rest for just a moment!
There! All better. Walking the raised walkways is more tiring than you'd think, isn't it?
